articles.summary: ACS37100, the industry's first 10 MHz TMR current sensor, unlocks the full potential of GaN & SiC FETs with a 50ns response time, enabling optimal efficiency and protection in high-frequency applications like xEVs and AI data centers.
articles.title: Allegro MicroSystems Unveils Industry’s First Production-Ready 10 MHz TMR Current Sensor - Press Release | Allegro MicroSystems
